Permits & License Committee  May 22, 2025
Minutes  Page 1 of 4

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  May 22, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
meeting ID 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281 on May 22, 2025 at 2:01 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh , Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department.
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department
  Boytrese Osias, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Destinee Wesley, City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on May 8, 2025.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Judith Wilson on behalf of HJ New Day New Way Recovery, Inc. to host an Our Community
  Cares- Food Giveaway Event at 8722 Crenshaw Blvd., Private Property; on Thursdays, May
  22,2025, June 26, 2025, July 24, 2025, August 21, 2025, September 25, 2025, October 23,
  2025, November 20, 2025, and December 18, 2025, from 12:30 pm – 3:00 pm APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY Approval for monthly event within Morningside United Church parking lot.;
  Applicant must ensure that there is NO vehicular traffic where pedestrians will be stationed
  in the parking lot; must have a minimum of one security guard for the safety of attendees,
  employees and voleunteers, must wear reflective vests for safety-visibility and ensure there
  is NO traffic congestion on Crenshaw Blvd or 88th St; None Code Conditions; None Fire
  recommendations; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately
  at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by
  the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00405737)

Item #2:  Councilwoman Dionne Faulk on behalf of The City of Inglewood to host a LA Riot-
  Neighborhood Kickoff Event at 2900 W. imperial Hwy; Crenshaw and Imperial Shopping
  Center parking Lot, Private Property; on Saturday, May 31, 2025, from 12:00 p.m. – 3:00

  p.m. Approval for 1 day event within Crenshaw/Imperial Shopping Center parking lot; There
  will be one (1) sergeant, two(2) police officers for public safety and two (2) TCO's for shopping
  center ingress-egress / traffic safety; ten (10) City Hall security staffing to assist IPD with
  any potential crowd control (Via public safety Spvr. Emory Ward). **Applicant will need to

  of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO.
  Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA
  County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00405658)

Item #3:  Otto Benedict on behalf of Live Nation at Sofi Stadium to host a Stray Kids-World Tour
  <dominate North America > Event at 1001 Stadium Dr.; SoFi Private Property; on Sunday,
  June 01,2025, from 7:30 p.m. -11:30 p.m. Approval for 1 day event within SoFi Stadium;
  None additional recommendations for Fire approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site
  is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask
  wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal
  Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously
  (Activity No. 00405749)

Item #4:  Rachel Shannon on behalf of Wilder’s Preparatory Academy Charter School to host an
  Annual School Wide Field Day Event at 700 Waren Lane; Edward Vincent Jr.Park, Public
  Property on Friday, June 06, 2025 from 7:30 a.m. – 1:30 p.m APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  Approval for 1 day event at Edward Vincent Park Subject to all applicable IMC regulations;
  Applicant shall hire or deploy school security staff and or parent volunteers for the safety of
  the students & staff. Security or parent volunteers shall monitor the restrooms being used by
  the students to deter any outside lewd contact activity; No Code Enforcement conditions;
  None recommendations for Fire Approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly
  cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event
  shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00405647)

Item #5:  Rachel Shannon on behalf of Wilder’s Preparatory Academy Charter School to host a Tree
  School Graduations Day Event at 700 Warren Ln; Edwaard Vincent Jr. Park – Amphitheatre;
  Public Property; on Tuesday, June 10, 2025, from 10:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY Approval for one (1) day event at Edward Vincent Park; Subject to Parks
  and Rec approval for use of the park; Subject to all applicable IMC regulations; Applicant to
  hire professional security or school staff for the safety of attendees; School safety or security
  staff shall monitor the restrooms being used by attendees to prevent any outside lewd
  conduct activity; The IPD watch commander will be notified and extra patrol will be provided

  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by

Item #6:  Teresa Avendano on behalf of South Bay Pop Ups LLC to host a Dia De Las Ranflas y
  Viclas Event at 1001 Stadium Dr, SOFI Stadium Way (Hollywood Parks) – Lot A, Private
  Property; on Saturaday, June 21, 2025, from 10:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m.; APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY Approval for 1 day event within Hollywood Park parking lot; must include
  a supervisor for traffic management and pedestrian flow; Applicant must also hire ten (10)
  Hollywood Park District-SoFi Stadium security staff to assist with internal event security and
  potential crowd control; All private security assigned to this event must wear high visibility
  reflective vests for identification and safety purposes; organizer must coordinate the possible
  use of vehicle barriers to restrict vehicular traffic near pedestrian activity areas;Applicant is
  responsibile for planning and implementing these barriers lies with event organizers including
  SoFi VP Otto Benedict and South Bay Pop-Ups leadership;event may include vendor booths,
  lowriders, custom bikes and musical entertainment; Police and security staff must closely
  monitor for any potential disturbances and unauthorized activity such as cruising or street
  takeovers.29th; None additional recommendations for Fire approval; Maintain site at all times,
  ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene
  and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA
  State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00405624)

New Business License Request (s):

Item #7:  Ngoc Giau Huynh DBA Today Nais & Spa to operate as a Hair/Nail Salon at 406 W.
  Manchester Blvd; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Business owner must
  possess and maintain valid and current Establishment License from the State Board of
  Barbering & Cosmetology;Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating
  within the establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board of Barbering
  & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the
  establishment is required to register and file business tax with the City; Business owner shall
  provide valid and current government-issued identification and copies of applicable state
  licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the establishment to the
  Finance Department; Parties, social events or gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited;
  Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use (including cannabis activity) is not
  permitted on the premises; Massage therapy of any part of the body is not permitted; Subject
  to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer or any Peace Officer at any

  and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any future
  business license application requests. (Activity No. 00405631)
